notes.title: Exciting News & Patch Update for Sneak Out Players!
notes.notes:
[h1] We’ve tackled the server issues in China and fine-tuned the gameplay mechanics. Thanks to your support, we've lifted our Steam rating from "mostly negative" to "mixed." We’re on a mission to elevate Sneak Out even further![/h1]

[b]Latest Patch Now Live on Steam![/b]

Ensure you're playing the latest version of Sneak Out by updating your game now! 

Here's what's new ⤵️

- [b]Decreased ally stuns:[/b] More fluid gameplay.
- [b]Reaper Hello There:[/b] Cooldown fix applied for balanced play.
- [b]Improved Clown Skill Descriptions:[/b] Clarity to enhance your strategy.
- [b]Armor T-Pose Bug:[/b] Now fixed for a smoother experience.
- [b]Friend List Sorting:[/b] Enhanced functionality.
- [b]Ghost Spawn Bug:[/b] Resolved to maintain game integrity.
- [b]East Maps Tasks:[/b] Bugs squashed for a seamless mission.


[b]We also need your help❗[/b]

☑️ [b]Try It Out:[/b] If you haven’t played recently, jump back in and see the improvements for yourself!

☑️ [b]Update Your Review:[/b] If your initial experience was less than perfect, consider revisiting your Steam review. Your updated feedback is invaluable!

☑️ [b]Join the Conversation:[/b] Share your thoughts in our Discord channels #ask-sneak-out and #sneak-out-suggestion!

[h2][b]Thank you for your commitment to Sneak Out. Together, we’re pushing forward to make this the game we all know it can be!

notes.notes:
[h2][b] Hi sneaky players! Here’s a message from our Chief Gaming Officer at Kinguin - Michał Kaczmarek who’s responsible for Sneak Out! [/b][/h2]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190768/8221268ffd3101bb41ed447a8eb3c1493e2e06cd.png[/img]

🔹 We have eliminated the resource-based economy from our game - for fairness

🔸 Items now spawn on the map directly, the same as in the playtests, as you’ve requested

🔹 We have refunded all Shards spent on upgrading the garden and have dramatically cut the skin prices

🔸 We are also tackling the black screen issue by upgrading our server infrastructure for stability, improving it significantly

[h3][b]
